question: Find the perimeter of a rectangle whose length and breadth are 5 cm and 8 cm.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The perimeter of a rectangle is simply twice the sum of its adjacent sides.

Sum of sides = 5 + 8 = 13 cm

Perimeter = 2 × 13 = 26 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 26 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length (L) = 5 cm

Breadth (B) = 8 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of a rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (5 + 8)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 13

⇒ Perimeter = 26 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 26 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Rectangle

The area is the total space enclosed by the boundary of the rectangle. Formula: Area = L × B.

Diagonal of a Rectangle

The diagonal divides the rectangle into two identical right-angled triangles. Formula: D = √(L² + B²).

Properties of a Rectangle

Opposite sides are equal and parallel, and all four interior angles are exactly 90°.
